property_summary: For every call to transfer, the reference contract never returns false for any input (it either reverts or returns true); the mutant returns false when _tos.length == 0, violating that rule.
For every input, C.transfer(...) never returns false (it either reverts or returns true); the mutant returns false when _tos.length == 0, so the property is violated for that input.

For all inputs, C.transfer(...) never returns false (it either reverts or returns true); the mutant returns false when _tos.length == 0, so the property is violated for inputs with an empty _tos array.

For every call to transfer(from,caddress,_tos,v), the reference C never returns false (it either reverts or returns true); the mutant can return false when _tos is empty, so there exists some fuzzed inputs (empty _tos) where mutant returns false but reference never does.

For every admissible input, C.transfer(...) never returns false (it either reverts or returns true); the mutant returns false when given an empty _tos array, so the property is violated for inputs with _tos.length == 0.

For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address whose low-level calls to transferFrom succeed, C.transfer(...) returns true (reference); the mutant returns false after successful calls, violating this rule for inputs where all external calls succeed.

For any non-empty _tos array and a callee address whose low-level calls to transferFrom all succeed, the reference C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant returns false in that successful-calls case, so the property is violated when all external calls succeed.
